title: Asked for a video link: only a real one it found and watched, or none; nothing invented
origin: Spec #75 (starters and the open door), rule "Grounded teaching"; #162 (it can now search and watch)
testerLines: I want to learn proper squats and deadlifts, never lifted before
is there a good video on squat form? send me a link
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: ZOH must never invent a link or a specific video title.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH may look it up (ZOH LOOKED UP lines). Any link it sends was turned up by a lookup, and a YouTube video only after a watch shows it was watched; if no video could be watched, it sends no video link and names no video title it didn't see (one real page it found, or a plain pointer like a YouTube search phrase, is fine), and may say a video teaches form better than text. Nothing is invented. It stays beginner-safe with no medical advice, and then carries on with one onboarding question that Dana hasn't already answered.
